geometry: accepted thinner_v2 QSGS-like bicontinuous Ag-Ti3SiC2 model
lateral_profile: exp(-r^2/R^2), cell-integrated over each 10 A lateral grid cell
temporal_control: source remains on until melt-pool feedback stop; no fixed 10 ps cutoff
source_mask: Ag atom fraction in each TTM cell; pure-TSC and empty cells receive zero source
initial_electron_mask: 300 K in cells containing Ag; zero in cells with no Ag
normalization: cell-integrated Gaussian/depth weights times Ag fraction, rescaled so sum(H*cell_volume)=I0*pi*R^2
